name: @kauro/identity
description: Kauro identity (O23A): the provider-neutral identity layer behind the B11 session boundary — pluggable identity providers (Identity Platform as served, Cognito as an offline candidate with its activation off), the step-up policy of sensitive actions, recovery codes, e-mail verification challenges, breached-password screening by k-anonymity, abuse limits, and the revocation of every session of a person. Offline simulators are the test-only subpath @kauro/identity/testing.
